# LX04 versioned owner wire data

C-LIGHT:1 semantics; explicit schema lx04-v1 for timed volatile service,
lx04-durable-v1 for explicitly enabled private durable service. These are new
provider artifacts, preserving accepted LX03 corpus bytes/provenance unchanged.
`timing.json` is generated by real timed Service over real LX02/LX04 Authority,
including preview/commit/midpoint/end/expiry and original cached commit outcome.
Nonce values are actual128-bit OS-random outputs. The executable regression
compares every value except random nonce bytes (normalised only during comparison),
and commits the actual newly generated private token, never a fabricated DTO.
Reproduce explicitly with LUX_GENERATE_LX04=1 cargo +1.97.1 test --locked -j1
--test timing lx04_encoded_provider_corpus, using parent host build lock/jobs1/
incremental0. No ordinary corpus rewriting is enabled.

Owner schema/timing/recovery: docs/notes/0030-release-recovery.md. Durable tests
use real private files, exclusive owner lock, two consecutive crashed CLI restarts
without another operator checkpoint, fresh epochs and old-command refusals. No
hardware, TCP, playback, MIDI, audio or display access. Output always null/disarmed,
physical unknown. Fixed private checkpoint paths are never client supplied.
